seoTitle: How to Download Jotform Submissions as PDF
metaDescription: Learn how to export Jotform submissions as PDF files in 2026 using the PDF Editor, including individual downloads and bulk ZIP archive exports.
intro: Whether you need a single signed contract or a batch of applicant records, Jotform's PDF Editor can convert form responses into clean downloadable documents. This guide covers opening the editor, customizing the layout, and downloading either individual entries or a full bulk export.

steps.heading: Select your target form
steps.body: Open your main form dashboard and select the project whose submissions you want to convert.

steps.heading: Open the PDF Editor
steps.body: Use the form dropdown menu to launch the PDF Editor panel.

steps.heading: Customize the document layout
steps.body: Adjust column margins and overall document layout formats to fit your submission data.

steps.heading: Toggle visible fields and branding
steps.body: Choose which submission fields display on the document and set up branding headers.

steps.heading: Download individual or bulk files
steps.body: Click the main download button to export a single entry as PDF, or process a bulk export as a ZIP archive of multiple submissions.

faq.question: Can I download all submissions at once instead of one at a time?
faq.answer: Yes, the PDF Editor supports bulk export, which downloads multiple entries together as a ZIP archive.

faq.question: Will the PDF include every field from the original form?
faq.answer: Only the fields you've toggled to be visible in the layout will appear on the exported PDF, so review that setting before downloading.

faq.question: Can I customize the header on my exported PDFs?
faq.answer: Yes, you can set up branding headers as part of the layout customization before exporting.

faq.question: Do downloaded PDFs update automatically if the submission changes later?
faq.answer: No, a downloaded PDF is a static snapshot, so you'll need to re-export if the underlying submission data is edited afterward.
